title: WSL systemd support
body:
This PR has 3 commits:

1. A check of the WSL version. Podman 6 doesn't work with WSL versions before v2.5.1 (cgroups v1). In that case, `machine init` fails. This is unrelated to WSL systemd support, which has been there since v0.67.6. The check is deliberately loose: we don't fail if we can't get the WSL version.

2. `machine init` configures the machine with the WSL-native systemd enabled (the main goal of this PR). The commands `machine start/stops` check whether the machine is new (using WSL systemd) or not (using namespaced systemd) and behave accordingly.

3. Undo b420cc6ca7567f5ac418ad7535cdfd9ab4c7bec4 that was a workaround because we were not using WSL systemd. 

Fixes:
- #15967
- #26098
- #29749
